[[File:Kevin Wilson.jpg|thumb|right|260px|[[Holotheatre]], 19 November 2020.]]
'''Kevin Wilson''' compiled version 3.0 of the ''Star Wars'' CCG Collecting Encyclopedia for the [[Players Committee]], published 17 November 2020.<ref name="enc30">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/collecting-encyclopedia-updated-with-eye-popping-enhancements/ Collecting Encyclopedia Updated with Eye-Popping Enhancements], starwarsccg.org (17 November 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210227063841/https://www.starwarsccg.org/collecting-encyclopedia-updated-with-eye-popping-enhancements/ Internet Archive].</ref> He was a guest on [[Holotheatre]] the next day.<ref name="ht-kw">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NaVhk9CrrV0 Star Wars CCG - 11/18/20 Holotheatre - Guests Justin Miyashiro & Kevin Wilson + Jerry Darcy Intervie], Star Wars CCG / Players Committee YouTube (19 November 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165210/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NaVhk9CrrV0 Internet Archive].</ref>
